result.summary: Found one minor visual inconsistency in the 'Popular right now' section; otherwise the page appears intact.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon treatment is inconsistent across the 'Popular right now' cards: the Tokumaru Ramen card shows a plain outline heart, while the pizza card below shows the same outline heart inside a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon styling across all cards—use either the plain outline consistently or the circular background consistently for visibility.
